body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose yourself. Until your next turn, reduce the first forced movement against you by 2 units and gain +1 Defense against Grapples.

surges.html: Gain +1 Defense against the next Action that targets you before your next turn.
Remove one Physical damage Condition from yourself.

rider.title: BARRIER — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, the first enemy that enters your reach before your next turn burns 1 die.
